chapter_title: To one who intends to give food or drink
chapter_title_arabic: الدعاء إذا أراد الطعام أو الشراب

duas.title: Dua when intending to give food or drink
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭ'im man aṭ'amanī wasqi man saqānī.
duas.english_translation: O Allah, feed the one who has fed me, and give drink to the one who has given me drink.
duas.arabic_text: اللّهُـمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَن أَطْعَمَني، وَاسْقِ مَن سقاني
